description: This file implements OBD-II communication protocols, handling CAN bus messages, responses to various PIDs, and DTC requests. It includes functions for constructing and sending OBD responses, managing supported PID bitfields, and responding to specific data requests such as engine load, coolant temperature, RPM, and vehicle speed.

methods.name: obdSendPacket
methods.description: Constructs and sends an OBD-II response packet over CAN bus with specified mode, PID, and data value.

methods.name: obdSendValue
methods.description: Converts a floating-point value to appropriate integer format and sends it as an OBD-II response.

methods.name: obdWriteSupportedPids
methods.description: Creates and sends a bitfield indicating supported PIDs within a specified range.

methods.name: handleGetDataRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming data requests for specific PIDs, fetching current sensor values or statuses, and responding accordingly.

methods.name: handleDtcRequest
methods.description: Constructs and sends a response containing DTC codes.

methods.name: obdOnCanPacketRx
methods.description: Processes incoming CAN packets with OBD-II requests and routes to appropriate handlers.
